_doc: Policy for dynamic hunt-network (game/fleet/hunt_net.py). Four priority lanes: (1) on-demand Escort/Protection (0 ships held when space is clear), (2) Coordinated Group Packs (3/5/8/10 ships targeting 25% of Military for tough wildlife & lone NPC pirates), (3) Power-Ratio Gated Solo Herd Hunting (auto-scales T0->T5+, F38 keep_herd=2, instant cooldown rotation), (4) Low-burn XP fallback.
_tune: Apophis 2026-11-24 15:29 UTC (orders ENT-089 block APOPHIS and P7: one pack first above the starters' gauges, F9/F37): first flight after hunt_net read the store (it found 0 herds before). One pack of 3 at a time (target_share 0.02 gives a quota of 3), members with a Pulse Laser III or better (min_member_power 900), wildlife only until three packs are read (pirates_enabled false), a rally of 10 minutes so a test group can meet; one escort at a time and only a tier-2 hull (min_power 1500). Lift after three pack results. 16:13 UTC: the stopgap list of 18 systems docking at our outpost emptied: hunt_net drops outposts from the docks (2eb93ba5). | Apophis 2026-11-25 00:40 UTC (rule 8.4, F22 danger): escort lane stopped. Four Military ships lost to NPC pirates in one hour on hunt-network escort runs (public_battles: kitalpha 23:34, 70_ophiuchi 23:38, sheliak 00:33 UTC; stats ships_lost 3 more at 00:00). The lane sends any ship of power >= 350 (sentinels and flagships >= 150, coded) to belts with pirates and has no gate of escort power against the pirates' threat. Back on when hunt_net weighs the escort side against the pirates read at the place (compute_target_threat role pirate) and sentinels obey min_power. | 00:41 UTC packs: pirates_enabled false and min_member_power 900 (Pulse Laser III or better) until three wildlife packs read kills: the three pack RESULT lines of 00:16 to 00:40 UTC read looted=0 (pilot whale, glintfin), starter packs cannot kill a whale (lesson 2026-11-22), and four ships fell to pirates this hour. Was {"pirates_enabled": true, "min_member_power": 500.0}. | Trinity 2026-11-25 00:50 UTC (Suggi doctrine + Apophis 00:40 UTC gate): escort lane re-enabled with min_escorts=3 everywhere (eliminated 1-ship legacy escorts), escort_power_ok() pirate-threat gate (compute_target_threat role=pirate, ratio>=1.8, hull+shield>=180, sentinels/flagships obey min_power=600 with no 150 bypass), lawless pre-entry rally wait (120s), and guard.py --defend active self-defense (fires back on attack, flees <40% hull). Apophis packs wildlife-only / min_member_power=900 gate preserved untouched.

war_wing._note: Dormant in peacetime (activates ONLY on active war in empire.json or explicit data/fleet/war-posture-on, rule F2).
